version.description: Required bare version without leading v, passed to the Dockerfile through the version-build-arg Docker build argument.

version-build-arg.description: Docker build argument name that receives version. Empty disables it. A same-named entry in build-args wins.

version-tag.description: Optional release version tag to apply to the image, usually prefixed with v.

channel-latest.description: Adds a mutable <version-channel>-latest tag when version-channel is set.

extra-tags.description: Optional newline-delimited extra image tags. Bare tags expand as image:tag; full image references pass through.

buildkit-endpoint.description: Optional remote BuildKit endpoint for self-hosted runners. When empty on a self-hosted runner, the runner's BUILDKIT_HOST environment variable is used if set; otherwise a local builder is created.

build-args.description: Optional newline-delimited Docker build arguments. Do not pass secrets here because Docker build args can persist in image metadata or logs.

enable-cache.description: Enables the generated GitHub Actions BuildKit cache when cache-from and cache-to are empty.

cache-from.description: Optional Docker Buildx cache-from value. Overrides the generated GitHub Actions cache when set.

cache-to.description: Optional Docker Buildx cache-to value. Overrides the generated GitHub Actions cache when set.

upload-diagnostics.description: Uploads the image metadata artifact when true. The upload is best-effort and never fails the job.
